name: Sanctuary · Earth
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 7-block radius for 18 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 3 ❤ earth (earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heals 5.5 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 15 s
• Growth: up to 15 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 7 blocks with 39% health
• Puts out fire
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 4.5 s
• Brittle (earth damage ×2) for 9 s
